Callout.Name: Drugs Found in a Cell
Callout.Message: Search has found drugs in a cell, occupant identified.

Script.Line: It was behind the vent, not on him.
Three of them share that cell and not one of them is talking.
There is more of it somewhere. There always is.

Lines.Approach: It was under the mattress and he is not arguing about it. Paperwork rather than a scene.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
